verdict.rationale: First-party docs say QuickBooks Payroll will calculate, file, and pay federal and state payroll taxes, with a 100% accurate calculation guarantee. They back this with up to $25,000 in tax penalty protection and expert-run filing, and payroll can be set to run automatically. Missing for 10: local payroll tax calculation/filing/remittance is not mentioned anywhere in the evidence, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of automated filing and remittance.
